run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the binary representation of the next number from a binary string
test_f_gold: test f_gold with binary string inputs to verify correct next number computation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to compute the next binary number using integer arithmetic instead of string manipulation
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like all-ones binary strings that require prepending a leading one
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which flips trailing ones to zeros and the first zero to one to increment a binary string
